ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0071 施設について質問する入力パネル. Input1 ORIGINAL controls glyph anatomy and heading+input structure. Input2 native mock supplies Japanese copy and font-role scale; its outlined five-point star is INCORRECT.

Align placeholder/button vertically with compact padding. Body and send optical scale follow mock; heading is the only bold text.
No suggestion chips, photos, tabs, extra helper text, phone, English, enclosing card, broad mint fill or large blank canvas. Flat high-resolution wide component with small white margins. Static raster candidate; query submission and assistant behavior unverified.
